required_fragments: The average channel fidelity of a quantum channel
where $ \Gamma $ is an effective depolarization rate
sections: main text average channel fidelity and leading-order rate
paper_audit.source_scope: TP experimental formula motivates six-state metric; CPTNI leakage extension is derived and independently tested in this project

metric_contract.entanglement_fidelity: Tr(PTM)/4 for the unnormalized CPTNI identity-target subchannel
metric_contract.average_fidelity: (2 F_e + R_II)/3, equal to direct Haar/six-state unnormalized overlap
metric_contract.tp_only_formula: (2 F_e + 1)/3 is allowed only when R_II=1
metric_contract.leakage_erasure_semantics: leaked weight has zero overlap with the target code state
metric_contract.conditional_fidelity: per-state diagnostic only; not a linear channel metric
metric_contract.short_time_rate: Gamma=-2 dF_avg/dt at t=0 via three-point second-order forward difference
metric_contract.short_time_reliability: qualified only when cycles 0-2 are nonincreasing and one/three/four-point relative spread is <=0.25

uncertainty_contract.reason: deterministic exact-channel evaluation has no stochastic sample population

parent_lane_config.scope: finite-cutoff six-state CPTNI logical subchannel tomography on a matched nominal-sBs versus idle cavity model; no postselection, multilevel leakage, device calibration, experimental tomography, target-board timing or LER claim

short_time_effective_depolarization.primary_definition: second-order three-point forward derivative of F_avg at t=0, Gamma=-2 dF_avg/dt
short_time_effective_depolarization.uncertainty_role: one/three/four-point spread is time-discretization sensitivity, not a statistical confidence interval

claim_boundary.allowed: leakage-inclusive finite-cutoff CPTNI F_e/F_avg, short-time effective rate and deterministic numerical sensitivity
forbidden: statistical CI from deterministic states or cutoffs
single-exponential replacement of average channel fidelity
qualified active short-time lifetime when cycle-scale transient fails reliability
experimental tomography, device calibration or hardware result
